notes: The joined subject has not successfully invoked Update Attribute Values when a distinct requester asks for HLAreportObjectInstancesUpdated. The slice verifies one reliable NULL response and checks the HLAobjectInstanceCounts parameter through the standard interaction callback. It makes no claim about nonzero counts, other MOM reports, transport-specific partitions, or overall conformance.

requirements.statement: The distinct requester uses the standard HLArequestObjectInstancesUpdated interaction and HLAfederate parameter to select the joined subject that has sent no successful updates.
The requester observes and validates the standard updated-object report interaction, transportation, tag, producer, and parameter map through the ordinary interaction callback.

When the joined subject has no object instances updated for the relevant transportation type, the standard MIM requires one NULL HLAreportObjectInstancesUpdated response whose HLAobjectInstanceCounts value is undefined and whose list representation is empty. The test accepts a zero-length undefined value or decodes a supplied standard variable array and requires zero count records.
